profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Team Builder and Stuff Maker | Ai | Rust C++ Python C
profile.summary:
As an engineer, I love building things: from low-level circuits and firmware all the way up through AI and computer vision models. I'm always learning, and always solving unprecedented challenges, resulting in several patents in Ai, Computer Vision, and Signal Processing.
As a leader, I have passion in bringing up everyone around me and building great teams.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Applying experience in Ai, software development, team building, mentorship, regulatory documentation, and startups to help Amperesand succeed in bringing solid-state transformers fully to market.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Systems Engineering · Technology Leadership · Machine Learning

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Handed off role of CTO. I'm continuing with previous development efforts supporting infrastructure and software stack build-out while getting RivalShot and myself into a great position to move in a new and exciting direction.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Lead development to create:
• a fully end-to-end encrypted communications library
• encrypted messaging client-broker
• peer-to-peer streaming video/audio calling system
• social media community platform that prioritizes user privacy

positions.title: Ai and Systems Engineering consultant
positions.description:
Worked with RivalShot owner and team to:
• evaluate python/tensorflow model for target shooting shot finding model running in Pi 2
• port python code into C++
• research faster approaches and alternatives that were more effective on constrained devices
• invent novel algorithmic approach for detecting stable changes on a target that opened up the possibility of running our software on low-power mobile phones
• create a multiplayer server to allow head-to-head competitions over the internet
• create data collection and processing system to enable further research and debugging of successful and failed sessions
• implement versions of algorithms in C++ to run on Android and WebAssembly (WASM)
• prototype initial version of encrypted communication system
• prototype initial version of distributed social media system

positions.title: VP of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Worked with executives and different departments to understand changing business goals and direction, while helping lead engineering team (coding, scoping, planning, mentoring):
• created an encrypted a HIPAA-compliant user PII database
• wrote a user mobile app data synchronization system
• coordinated with Chinese firmware/hardware vendors on a health tracking wearable device
• an appointment management system
• applied blockchain concepts to the PII system to as anti-tampering and data validation mechanism
• created an electronic signatures system to provide regulatory proof that stored data and user
agreements had not been tampered with.
• Adhered to FDA software documentation and testing standards (ISO-13485)
• work with 3rd party vendors to integrate various data flows and synchronization between different systems

positions.title: VP of Machine Learning and Engineering
positions.description:
Built up, worked with, managed, and mentored an international team of developers. Worked with product manager and executives to:
• Created an Ai PaaS, allowing people to create a A.I., data processing, or any other event-based pipelines, easily creating different independent and distributable nodes that worked together and a were easy to deploy.
• Created a pluggable datasets store, for easy selection and use by different pipeline
• Help create new IP around combining two different types of Ai, CNNs and HTMs for faster, more efficient model creation.
• Used several types of off-the-shelf DB's in addition to writing my own implementations of key-value, caching, relational, and document databases when embedding was required in different use cases
• Use Docker and proprietary containerization approaches to isolate and scale distributed workloads
• Wrote a secure, highly scalable multi-tenant architecture.
• Wrote an MQTT 3.1 message server for pub-sub coordination between different components in our app

positions.title: Freelance Ai/Computer Engineer: Firmware development
positions.description:
Worked with Innovative Drive Corporation (IDC) engineering teams and clients as a firmware and tools developer to assist their clients with medical device development. Some projects include:
• Developing firmware, sensor drivers, and detection algorithm for Melzi: https://melzisurgical.com
• Creating various Python-based tools for visualization and realtime device data streaming/debugging
• Writing high speed sensor sampling code for metallic impact detection application
• Debugging rf and bluetooth issues with various microcontroller + transceiver combos
• Assisting Electrical Engineering with component selection and PCB testing/debugging
• Untold hours of hardware, circuit, firmware, and data sheet debugging, including discovering several compiler bugs
• Implemented various network and communication protocols from scratch as necessary to meet memory/speed constraints
• Implemented several network services to communicate with wifi-connected devices and support over-the-air updates, such as with esp32
• Followed FDA device software documentation regulations

positions.title: Freelance Ai/Computer Engineer: Computer vision analysis pipeline
positions.description:
Worked with HealthReel to:
• build a mobile video data collection pipeline
• research and develop a computer vision algorithm for generating 3d models of the human body
• collect and clean video data
• create web API to facilitate the the video and machine learning activities of the code
• collaborated with other app development vendor to help integrate local (on-device) and remote functions together
• Cleanly handed off code and documentation

positions.title: Freelance Ai/Computer Engineer: Custom Chatbot Framework
positions.description:
Worked with client who owned multiple marketing and media websites interested in using Ai in their stack. Working with them, I built:
• a neural network model for "intent" classification
• a conversation graph flow builder, for designing branching conversation flows
• dataset upload and model retraining interface; given a file with the correct format, kick of retraining of the chatbot model
• an NLP-based knowledge graph builder that could build profiles memories from user conversation/interactions with the bot
• Documentation on how it all worked

positions.title: AppBank Operations L2 Support
positions.description: Continued in previous position, except as a full employee (rather than an external vendor).
positions.insights: Skills: System Architecture · Multicultural Team Building · Programming · Debugging · Computer Architecture · People Management · Complex Systems · Technical Leadership · Software Development · Computer Engineering · IT Infrastructure Management · Multithreading · Operating Systems · Network Services

positions.title: Contingent IT Worker at Goldman Sachs - Appbank Market Risk
positions.locationName: Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
positions.description:
While helping lead a team of amazing support engineers, I supported and debugged mission-critical, highly distributed applications and global operations across a variety of OS's (Linux, Unix, Windows), databases, programming and scripting languages.
• Worked with various different teams to revive a stalled mass data migration project from legacy systems and storage, then executed it on live application with zero downtime or interruptions.
• Worked with a Market Risk modeler to resolve a long-standing and deeply convoluted bug in one of the risk simulations.
• Execute and monitor distributed model simulations
• Debug distributed simulation applications when they fail for any reason, at all levels, including OS, permissions, network, DB, storage, or source code (in various programming languages)
• Propose, and as required, seek permission to proactively fix code, permissions, accesses, etc. 
• Create run books for different processes as needed
• Support team as necessary
• Participate in on-call support rotation
• Coordinate across teams, departments, and domains to resolve and improve upon processes to avoid repeated issues

positions.title: Contingent IT Worker at Goldman Sachs - Global Helpdesk
positions.description:
Handle and debug incoming issues across a wide variety of systems, equipment, and applications, for Goldman Sachs employees all around the world.
• Write runbooks where none exist
• Write command line scripts in powershell to automate common repeat processes such as clearing remote temporary files, resetting passwords, restarting systems
• Coordinate with different specialist teams (email, storage, communications, provisioning) to resolve issues for employees.
• Had one of the highest support review feedback scores due to my care and attention to properly resolving issues.

positions.title: I.T. Ninja
positions.description:
• Managed network, server, and workstation maintenance to ensure seamless business operations.
• Developed Information Security skills through penetration testing and network intrusion detection.
• Implemented open-source IDS Linux distribution into client network for enhanced security.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Windows Server · Debugging · Storage Area Network (SAN) · Computer Architecture · Linux System Administration · Honeypots · Computer Engineering · IT Infrastructure Management · Multithreading · Operating Systems · Communication

positions.title: Chinese Builder
positions.description:
• helped coordinate the course development of a first-year Chinese language course
• help produce content, including editing audio and coming up with innovative solutions for using outside media on Middlebury Interactive's online course platform. 
• help edit and review both Chinese and English
• arrange contacts with native Chinese speakers for audio recording sessions
• Support others to help meet deadlines and move projects forward
positions.insights: Skills: Multicultural Team Building · Project Management · Communication

positions.title: Courier, Teaching and Learning Technologies
positions.description: Deliver, set up, manage, and maintain audio visual equipment including but not limited to: high lumens projectors, speaker systems (including PA systems), cameras, digital recorders, wireless microphones, and other electronics. Keep track of equipment reservations, check-outs, and returns using an online database system. Answer phone calls, fielding basic questions and escalating other questions to specialists in the department.  Maintain classroom audiovisual systems, performing basic troubleshooting and repairs, while going to school full time.

projects.title: Example network services in Rust
projects.description: An ongoing work in progress to create often encountered network services used in most businesses.

projects.title: High efficiency, non-neural network general purpose AI Algorithm
projects.description:
After several years of thought, I had the paid opportunity to dedicate several months into building and designing a multi-purpose algorithm which can be applied to Ai, data compression, and various other domains with the ability to speed up wide swaths of mathematical operations that currently rely on large matrix operations and specialty hardware such as GPUs, TPUs, or FPGAs. Algorithm is lightweight enough for microcontrollers or embedded devices, or massively parallelizeable on those devices.

Algorithm is tunable for fuzziness, exactness, space/time compute, and ridiculously scalable in both is training and inference, even on ancient hardware where we obtained results greater than current SOTA on modern specialized chips.

Algorithm is currently patent-pending, and we're still continuously finding new use cases for its application.

patents.title: Automatic target scoring machine
patents.description: A very fast, non-NN algorithm for detecting bullet holes in targets

patents.title: Metal detection device and methods of operation thereof
patents.description: Created sensor processing algorithm for laparoscopic needle detection device, as well as the firmware upon which it ran. Also assisted in microcontroller selection, PCB debugging, and Ui/Ux behavior of lights, sound, and safety failsafes.
